utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Ira, are you still planning to help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, I am — I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time should I count on you?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — what do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, remind me what’s on the list again? I might’ve missed the update.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can check the list with you — I remember basic tools, tape, screws, and a couple extension cords. If you want, I can grab what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely — folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you need anything specific, I can keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s good to hear — I’m just worried about whether we’ve got enough boxes and a way to sort everything. If you spot any labels or packing tape, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye out for labels and packing tape, and I’ll ask around about extra boxes too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you bring the box of spare screws and the cordless drill from my garage shelf? I’ve got them set aside near the back door.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll grab the box of spare screws and the cordless drill from your garage shelf and bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m hearing the repair drive is coming up soon—want me to pass along the details to anyone who might help?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. If you could share it with folks nearby, I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word to the neighbors nearby and let them know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo — I’m putting the repair drive details in order now. Tell me what’s most urgent, and I’ll make sure we cover it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa. The fence and the porch light are the most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Got it — I’ll put the fence and porch light at the top of the list. I’ll start lining up help for those first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m happy to help—what details do we know about the repair drive so far?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Not much yet—I’m probably arriving late, but I can help once I’m there. Do you know what still needs to be fixed?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet, so I’d want to confirm the list before we start. If you get there late, just check in and I’ll help sort out what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school drop-off and pickup, so just let me know what time the repair drive is happening.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be a huge help, thanks. I’ll send you the repair drive time as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll keep my schedule flexible and watch for your update.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive coming up—what do we need to bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mostly tools and any broken items you want checked—if you’ve got a lamp, bike, or small appliance, bring it along. I can help figure out what the folks there can fix.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps — I’ll bring my old lamp and maybe a few tools if I can find them. Do you know what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still good to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m still good to help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out—what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey — I’m a bit scattered, but I know we still need help with the loose porch step and that leaky faucet at Mrs. Alvarez’s place. If you’re up for it, I can show you where to start.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, show me where to start, and I’ll take the porch step first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep folks posted. Let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye on supplies and let you know if we’re short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep neighbors updated and pass along any changes I hear.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet, but I can swing by and check while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, Ira. Thanks for checking in and letting me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll stop by and see what I can find out, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was meaning to ask if you need a hand with anything. I might be a bit forgetful, but I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — I’d love a hand sorting donations and handing out flyers. I’ll keep you posted on when we start.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely, just let me know when and where to show up. I’ll do my best not to forget the flyers this time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, I might’ve missed the latest update—what’s changed?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: They moved it to Saturday morning and the drop-off is by the community center. If you’ve got anything broken, just bring it over.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — Saturday morning by the community center. I’ll try to bring what I can over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. Let’s keep it simple: bring the tools over at 9, and I’ll have the list ready.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll bring the tools by 9 and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Amazing—thank you! We still need a few more hands for sorting supplies and setting up the tables; I’ll send you the details right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, send them over and I’ll help with sorting supplies or setting up tables.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect people for the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you send me the list of folks who still need a hand, along with their addresses if you have them?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll gather the list and any addresses I have, then send it over to you.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted. If you’ve got any specific supplies or volunteer names, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check our supplies list and send over anything we still need, plus a few names of folks who can help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Cleo — that’ll help a lot. I’ll wait for your list and then I’ll start matching folks to tasks.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is getting organized soon—what do you know about it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don’t know the details yet—who’s organizing it, and what repairs are they planning?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure yet—I just caught that it’s in the works. If I hear more, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what do you need from the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can swing by after school drop-off, but I need to know what’s left to pick up and when it needs to be there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not totally sure what’s left yet — I’ll check and send you the list. If you can, aim for later today after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You can help, but I’d like to confirm what you’re able to bring first—do you have tools, supplies, or just time?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ve got time and a basic toolbox, and I can grab supplies if you tell me what’s needed.
